dedupe_keys.name: saudi aramco in house basin simulator

description: Aramco describes an in-house basin simulator for geological evolution and hydrocarbon migration in Arabian sedimentary basins. It integrates reservoir geological information and includes a Hybrid Darcy migration method. The provider is Saudi Aramco EXPEC Advanced Research Center. Coverage: The described application concerns the Arabian Peninsula and geological timescales of millions of years. The provider account is from 2017 and does not establish a current release or resolution. Access: The company publishes a description of the internal simulator and user workshops. No public software distribution or route to external use was established. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: This records the documented internal model, not an obtainable public package. Proposed graphical additions in the 2017 account are not confirmed as delivered. For simulation it identifies a documented basin-modelling method used in hydrocarbon exploration. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this Aramco basin simulator.
